title: DCH
tagline: A decentralized publication management protocol with enhanced privacy features tailored for writers
description: Decentralized Creators Hub (DCH) is a blockchain-based platform that empowers content creators to securely publish, distribute, and monetize their work through decentralized ownership and tokenized incentives.                                                                       .
